messages:
maria-s: Heads up — we just saw a sudden 8-12% 5xx rate on hosted inference (api-router) starting ~1746604200. Dashboard spike and lots of customer errors. https://grafana/redwood/alerts :grimacing:
deploy-bot: deploy finished: rollforward v2026.03.15+canary -> prod @1746604000 by kevin-eng :rocket:
kevin-eng: I rolled the routing-toggle 'new-auth-parse' to 100% in prod as part of the rollforward. I did not expect it to touch header parsing logic.
jamie-support: multiple customers opened tickets: AcmeCorp, PixlLabs — requests failing with 503 and "auth parse error". Customers report billing ops failing too.
opsbot: prod-router logs (sample):
```
[2026-03-15T14:00:10Z] ERROR upstream request failed: parse.authz: unexpected token at position 12
[2026-03-15T14:00:11Z] 503 ServiceUnavailable user_id=acme-123 request_id=xyz
```
kevin-eng: ugh. looks like the toggle enabled a new auth header normalization that breaks truncated JWTs we still accept. We tested with full tokens only. My bad.
maria-s: Can we hold traffic and rollback? We have customer impact.
sre-lead: Agreed. -> ACTIONS: 1) rollback toggle/rollforward 2) open short-term fallback route to legacy parser 3) post-mortem to tighten toggle gating. Kevin, can you initiate rollback now? :warning:
kevin-eng: starting rollback now. Command I ran in staging.
```
kubectl -n prod patch deployment api-router -p '{"spec":{"template":{"metadata":{"annotations":{"rollout":"rollback-to-v2026.03.14"}}}}}'
```
kevin-eng: also preparing a k8s rollback: `kubectl -n prod rollout undo deployment/api-router --to-revision=345`
jamie-support: I paged affected customers with ETA ~15m for rollback. Logging all ticket ids in the incident doc.
opsbot: quick repro for SRE: curl against prod to see 503:
```
curl -i -X POST https://api.redwood.com/v1/chat -H "Authorization: Bearer <truncated>" -H "Content-Type: application/json" -d '{"input":"test"}'

HTTP/1.1 503 Service Unavailable
x-request-id: xyz
x-error: parse.authz: unexpected token
```
sre-lead: Good repro, thanks. Kev — keep us updated on rollback status and whether we need an emergency patch to accept truncated JWTs. Also check any routing rules that depend on normalized header names.
kevin-eng: rollback completed to revision 345 at 1746605100. Error rate dropping, currently 1.2% 5xx and trending down.
maria-s: Confirming customers report fewer failures. Jamie, keep monitoring billing errors.
jamie-support: AcmeCorp confirmed transient failures cleared, but asked for root cause and RCA. I told them we'll follow up after postmortem. :white_check_mark:
sre-lead: Next steps: create follow-up ticket to add unit tests for truncated token cases, add canary perf/auth smoke to rollout gating, and add a short circuit fallback to legacy parser for 10m after toggles. Assigning owners: kevin-eng for fix, maria-s for postmortem, jamie-support for customer comms.
maria-s: I'll start the incident timeline and link logs + rollout diff. Thanks team. :heart:
deploy-bot: Note: automatic canary metric alerts suppressed during rollback window per policy.
opsbot: Incident closed as active regression mitigated at 1746606325. Will convert to follow-up tasks.
